segments.name: Pet products and services
segments.description: Online retailer of pet products, supplies, prescriptions and pet health services for pet parents in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment and one reportable segment organized around the sale of pet products and services, as the CODM reviews financial information presented on a consolidated basis for purposes of making operating decisions, allocating resources, and evaluating financial performance.

revenueModel.text: Pet parents pay Chewy for pet products, prescriptions and health services purchased through its websites and mobile applications, including recurring Autoship subscription orders.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe that the trend of subscription-based purchasing behavior within the broader trend towards online shopping supports higher levels of customer retention and revenue visibility.
